messages:
Maya (support): Heads up — AcmeAnalytics (acct: acct_0A1B2C) just flagged that promo credits from 2025-09-30 were consumed before older free-tier credits. Dashboard shows 0 remaining, but the invoice line item still lists 50 promo credits. Can we triage?
Jordan (billing): Thanks, Maya. Can you paste the invoice ID and the promo code id? Also wondering if this is an indexing/display bug vs actual debit order.
Maya (support): Invoice ID inv_20260112_992, promo id promo_Q3BATCH_09. Customer attached screenshots showing dashboard credits timeline and API usage from last 48h.
Maria S (customer): hey — we started a burst test yesterday (10k tokens) and noticed the account consumed the new promo bundle first and then our monthly free tier. We expected FIFO (older credits first). This caused an unexpected overage on the billed invoice.
Alex H (eng): Filing quick note: our credit application policy should be oldest-first unless overridden. Possible race with batch promo-attach job on promo redemption, or the billing-aggregation job applied promos in a different priority. Can you share the exact timestamps of the burst calls?
Maya (support): API call window: 2026-01-11 22:14:03 UTC -> 2026-01-11 22:22:47 UTC (approx). Customer says they redeemed promo at 2026-01-11 22:10:30 UTC, but the promo shows "applied" in billing at 22:30 in the dashboard.
Sam (eng-infra): If promo redemption recorded later in DB but with earlier effective_ts due to batch processing, we might reorder credits when constructing the per-account ledger. Need full ledger dump.
Lukas (sre): Can we attach the usage/ledger lines for acct_0A1B2C between 2026-01-11 21:00 and 2026-01-12 01:00? Look for entries with tags: promo_id:promo_Q3BATCH_09 and free_tier_mark. Also check the consumer_id for the burst job to rule out a duplicate/multi-tenant tagging problem.
Maya (support): Pasting sanitized ledger snippet below (from internal tool):
```
2026-01-11T22:10:30Z  ACCT acct_0A1B2C  ACTION attach_promo promo_Q3BATCH_09  credits_added=100
2026-01-11T22:14:04Z  ACCT acct_0A1B2C  ACTION usage tokens=10240  cost_units=10
2026-01-11T22:14:04Z  ACCT acct_0A1B2C  ACTION credit_debit source=free_tier credits_used=8
2026-01-11T22:14:04Z  ACCT acct_0A1B2C  ACTION credit_debit source=promo_Q3BATCH_09 credits_used=2
2026-01-11T22:20:00Z  ACCT acct_0A1B2C  ACTION usage tokens=5120  cost_units=5
2026-01-11T22:20:00Z  ACCT acct_0A1B2C  ACTION credit_debit source=promo_Q3BATCH_09 credits_used=5
```
Maya (support): So ledger shows mixed consumption (both free and promo used). Customer says dashboard UI shows promo consumed first — which is what they were billed for. Invoice still lists leftover 50 promo credits.
Jordan (billing): Invoice mismatch could be caused by async invoice generation vs final ledger reconciliation. We need to confirm whether the invoice used a snapshot at invoice generation time that included the promo as unused. If ledger later shows consumption, invoice might not have been updated. But invoice should reflect final ledger — this is bad.
Alex H (eng): Hypothesis: two processes (promo-attach job and ledger-merge job) run concurrently. If promo attach commits to the promo table but ledger-merge reads cached credits order, it's possible credits were applied in-memory in a different order for token consumption. Also the UI derives remaining credits from invoices in some cases — check UI code path.
Maya (support): Customer asked for repro steps. They ran a short script hitting our completions endpoint with a single API key in a tight loop. They can reproduce if we want to replicate in staging.
Lukas (sre): Can we reproduce with a synthetic test: 1) create acct, 2) create free-tier credits (30), 3) attach promo (100), 4) run burst 1k toks, and inspect ledger to confirm debit order. I'll spin up a job in staging.
Sam (eng-infra): I'll provision a staging run and attach a tracing span to the billing pipeline. Need a short window to test.
Jordan (billing): For customer remediation: propose crediting 50 promo credits back (to match invoice) as a temporary fix and then run full reconciliation. Need ops approval for manual credit. @Maya (support) please confirm customer OK with a manual credit and get their confirmation.
Maria S (customer): yes please, a temporary credit would be appreciated while you investigate. We don't want unexpected overage charges.
Maya (support): Noted. Customer confirmed. I'll create a support ticket to run manual credit and mark it P1-safety.
Alex H (eng): Engineering next steps: 1) capture more ledger traces, 2) add stronger ordering guarantees in ledger merge (enqueue credits by created_at), 3) patch UI to read from reconciled ledger not invoice snapshot. I'll open an internal ticket and reference this thread.
Lukas (sre): After repro completes, please attach the staging trace link here. If we see non-deterministic ordering, we'll need a hotfix for the merge window.
credits-bot: Reminder — created cloud job job_ledger_reconcile_20260112 queued with priority high.
Maya (support): Thank you all. Action items: Sam run staging test (ETA 2h), Alex open eng ticket, Jordan queue manual credit (awaiting approvals), will update customer after staging results.
Jordan (billing): Manually queued credit — txn_ref: manual_credit_acct_0A1B2C_20260112. Will hold settlement until reconciliation completes.
Maya (support): Closing loop with customer now. I'll post update thread when we have staging trace. :white_check_mark:
Maria S (customer): thanks team — appreciate the quick response.
Maya (support): Thread closed for now; will reopen if repro shows different root cause.
